messages:
mia: opened a PR to consolidate Dedicated capacity docs, tighten the autoscale examples, and add a short migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4138

alex: thanks — I'll check terraform + SDK snippets and SLA references.

sophia: can we make the migration checklist explicit about cordon vs drain? customers ask this a lot.

mia: included 4-step checklist. step 2 mentions cordon first, drain only if you accept in-flight evictions.

raul: nit: use `redwood.capacity/isolation=dedicated` in the terraform example (we removed the old annotation last quarter). updated suggestion in PR comment.

jen: spotted an SLA inconsistency: one doc says 99.9% and another 99.95%. which is correct for Dedicated?

mia: Dedicated is 99.95% for reserved pools. fixed the table and updated the text.

alex: SDK method changed recently. current example should be `client.capacity.create_dedicated(...)` not `client.dedicated.provision(...)`. please update before merge.

mia: updated Python snippet in the PR: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.capacity.create_dedicated(name="analytics-dedicated", gpu_type="a100", autoscale={"policy":"balanced"})
print(resp.id)
```

sophia: terraform example updated too?

mia: new terraform snippet now uses the standardized annotation and balanced autoscale policy:```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "example" {
  name = "analytics-dedicated"
  gpu  = "a100"
  annotations = {
    "redwood.capacity/isolation" = "dedicated"
  }
  autoscale_policy = "balanced"
}
```

raul: add an FAQ entry about min_replicas interaction with soft-eviction — people set min_replicas=0 and still see evictions during short windows.

mia: added FAQ: "Why did my pool preempt even with min_replicas=0?" uses product glossary term preempt and links to internal explainer. also added note: metrics stabilize ~48h after migration.

jen: style nits left inline. also we should ensure changelog mentions migration doc for product.

sophia: small ask: include a placeholder diagram for isolation levels (shared / reserved / dedicated) and ping design for an 800x400 PNG. I'll follow up with a PR for the exported image.

mia: placeholder image and alt text added. pinged design separately.

alex: CI is flaky but kicked a docsite build.

deploy-bot: docsite build started for PR #4138

deploy-bot: docsite build passed — preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/pr-4138/ :tada:

mia: plan: merge tomorrow noon PST unless there are objections.

jen: ship with placeholder, follow up for diagram.

sophia: +1. I'll open a follow-up PR for the PNG.

raul: +1. reminder: update release notes so PMs can call out the migration guidance.

mia: added changelog entry and merging. thanks all!
